items.headline: ETRM modernization wave keeps lifting vendor growth
items.summary: Consultancy capSpire reported strong 2026 growth, attributing momentum to ETRM modernization projects, two strategic acquisitions and rising AI-driven demand across energy and commodity trading desks.

items.headline: IFC and Citi launch $2bn trade finance facility
items.summary: The IFC and Citi unveiled a new $2bn facility aimed at expanding trade financing access for corporates and SMEs across Africa, Asia and Latin America, building on prior IFC programs that have already funded roughly $65bn in emerging-market trade.

items.headline: ACER moves to clarify REMIT-EMIR reporting overlap
items.summary: ACER is updating its REMIT guidance following the 2024 REMIT revision and 2026 data-reporting rules, aiming to clarify which energy derivatives remain reportable under REMIT versus EMIR and how to avoid duplicate reporting.

items.headline: Tanker attacks jolt oil freight and shipping routes
items.summary: Brent crude settled over $3 a barrel higher after new tanker attacks disrupted flows, a development operations teams should watch for its knock-on effects on freight rates, voyage insurance and routing decisions.
